## Limitations
- Small dataset from a single region (hospitals in Kerala, India, per the dataset description): results may not transfer to other populations or ethnicities.
- Self-reported symptoms are subjective; the model estimates similarity to diagnosed cases, it does not diagnose.
- Subgroups with fewer than 15 people are not scored (too small to be meaningful).
- The threshold is chosen on the same cross-validated predictions it is evaluated on, so the reported sensitivity/specificity are slightly optimistic (nested CV or a held-out test set would fix this).
- The training data has a much higher PCOS rate than the general population, so scores are not calibrated probabilities and PPV in the real world would be lower.
- Ages and BMIs outside the training range are flagged in the app as less reliable.
